site_observations.homepage: Opening https://www.ign.com/ redirected to https://jp.ign.com/ in the validation browser.
site_observations.chosen_start_url_result: Stayed on the English IGN site and exposed Editors' Choice, Score Range, and Genre filters.
site_observations.cookie_dialog: A privacy consent dialog may cover the filter controls on a fresh session.

static_result.title: Undaunted: Stalingrad Board Game Review
evidence: The filtered results list showed one matching score-10 review.
The detail page showed score 10 and EDITORS' CHOICE.
The title and article text identify it as a board game review.

latest_experiment.superseded_reason: After this run, the additive task was restored to the existing Formal3 decomposition. Its milestone received only a minimal semantic broadening.
interpretation: The static task reached max_steps, so this run does not isolate dynamic-goal ability from base navigation ability.
The override task reached a qualifying initial-goal article, but the list-state-only milestone did not fire; the milestone is narrower than the semantic progress required by the task.

DeepSeek wrapped its final send_msg_to_user call in angle brackets. The runner and evaluator exact-prefix checks did not recognize the wrapper, causing the submission to be classified as terminated and its non-empty done message to be evaluated as empty.
Static again failed before submission, so base navigation remains uncalibrated for this model and site.
The restored additive task no longer requires Editors' Choice or score filtering before its revision, but the agent still failed to display a verifiable IGN board game review list or detail page.
No angle-bracket action wrapper occurred in either retest trajectory.

known_risks: IGN is a live site, so result counts and the expected conditional branch can change.
The set must be revalidated before a frozen experiment batch.
The milestone definitions and angle-bracket action parsing issue must be fixed before the pilot is repeated.
